definitions.explanation: A channel attached to the edge of a roof to collect and drain rainwater away from the building.

examples.japanese: {雨樋|あまどい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まっている→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧。
examples.english: The rain gutter is clogged with fallen leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{雨樋|あまどい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: The rain gutter was damaged by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {雨樋|あまどい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水漏|みずも}れ→水漏れ：07936_mizumore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't clean the gutters, it can cause water leaks.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {雨|あま} (rain) + {樋|とい} (gutter, pipe). The {樋|とい} becomes どい through rendaku (sequential voicing).

ALTERNATE WRITING: Sometimes written as {雨|あま}どい or あまどい.

COMPONENTS OF GUTTER SYSTEM:
- {軒樋|のきどい}: horizontal gutter along the eave
- {竪樋|たてどい}/{縦樋|たてどい}: vertical downspout
- {集水器|しゅうすいき}: funnel/collector
- {這|は}い{樋|どい}: gutter running along the ground

MAINTENANCE:
- ⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: to get clogged
- ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean
- ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧: to remove fallen leaves

MATERIALS:
- {塩|えん}ビ: PVC (most common)
- ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧: copper (traditional)
- ⟦アルミ→アルミ：08942_arumi⟧: aluminum

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{軒|のき}→軒：03912_noki⟧: eaves
- ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧: roof
- ⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧: drainage
